review_method: Executing-agent scoped final role reviews; no independent human or release acceptance implied.

findings: Corrective scope resolves the reported first-run bootstrap bug under existing authority. Original P0-007 closure remains intact; P1 live R2 prerequisite remains open.
Only mount-property existence detection changes. Existing mount name, configuration, policy contents, credential mechanism and operation ordering are preserved.

Native authority verification checks 168 artifacts; revision allocation, approval and activation are allowed. Candidate includes exact ownership classification; both owned Git objects match tested SHA and working tree.

Full bootstrap runs with command doubles pass all nine cases in PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1: first run creates the mount, repeat run preserves it, and provider failures halt later operations.

Secret scan/SAST pass 1243 files with unchanged rules. Synthetic private input is redacted from captured output. Original policies and transport settings are unchanged; actual root token remains with the operator.

18 scenario executions pass across both runtimes. Coverage includes empty/unrelated/existing mounts, listing failure, malformed JSON, create failure, both policy failures and credential-free status. Prior harness and host-policy failures are retained.

Exact tested SHA, local receipt hashes, two owned Git blobs and original closed-record preservation are verified. These are executing-agent scoped reviews; no independent human approval or actual operator policy-application success is claimed.
